results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if workspace context unknown or scope errors)] [Prerequisite]: Discover accessible workspaces using CLICKUP_GET_AUTHORIZED_TEAMS_WORKSPACES (select a valid team_id for downstream calls).
[Optional (if space_id unknown)] [Prerequisite]: List spaces using CLICKUP_GET_SPACES (select target space_id for list discovery).

[Required (if list_id unknown, stale, or may be unwritable)] [Prerequisite]: Discover a writable destination list using CLICKUP_GET_FOLDERS (scan nested folders→lists; handle offloaded/truncated results[0].response.data shapes; capture list_id exactly).
[Optional (if no suitable list found under folders)] [Fallback]: Find a writable list using CLICKUP_GET_FOLDERLESS_LISTS (choose one that allows task creation).
[Optional (if setting status or unsure allowed values)] [Prerequisite]: Validate list configuration using CLICKUP_GET_LIST (use an allowed status label verbatim or omit status).

[Required] [Step]: Create the task/subtask using CLICKUP_CREATE_TASK (send intended fields; use UTC epoch-ms for schedule fields with *_date_time flags; set parent only for subtasks; capture created task identifier).

[Optional (for verification or if create response is verbose/truncated)] [Next Step]: Retrieve the created task using CLICKUP_GET_TASK (verify status, assignees, custom fields, and date normalization).
known_pitfalls: [CLICKUP_GET_SPACES] 401 ECODE OAUTH_176/OAUTH_192 can indicate wrong team_id or missing scopes—reselect via CLICKUP_GET_AUTHORIZED_TEAMS_WORKSPACES.
[CLICKUP_GET_FOLDERS] Large nested payloads may be truncated/offloaded; lists can appear only under results[0].response.data and folders may look empty even when lists exist.
[CLICKUP_GET_FOLDERLESS_LISTS] Can legitimately return an empty lists array even when foldered lists exist—treat as fallback only.
[CLICKUP_GET_LIST] 400 ECODE CRTSK_001 if status is invalid/localized; avoid guessing status labels.

[CLICKUP_CREATE_TASK] 404 ECODE SHARD_006 with invalid/stale destination identifiers; 400 ECODE FIELD_158 when label-type custom fields need option IDs; some destinations reject multiple assignees (e.g., ITEM_417).

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: ClickUp unifies tasks, docs, goals, and chat in a single platform, allowing teams to plan, organize, and collaborate across projects with customizable workflows
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=clickup. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="clickup") to create a connection BEFORE executing any clickup tools.

CLICKUP_CREATE_TASK.description: Creates a new ClickUp task in a specific list, optionally as a subtask if a `parent` task ID (which cannot be a subtask itself and must be in the same list) is provided.

name.description: The name of the new task.

parent.description: ID of an existing task to be the parent (creating a subtask). Parent must not be a subtask and must be in the same list.

status.description: Status name for the task. IMPORTANT: Each ClickUp list has its own unique status configuration. Common names like 'todo', 'done', or 'in progress' often do NOT exist - you must use the exact status names (case-sensitive) configured in the target list. To get valid statuses, call GET /list/{list_id} and check the 'statuses' array in the response for available status names. If omitted, uses the list's default status (recommended when valid statuses are unknown).

list_id.description: The ID of the list where the task will be created.

team_id.description: Team ID, required only if `custom_task_ids` is `true`.

due_date.description: Due date as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

links_to.description: ID of an existing task to link as a dependency.

assignees.description: User IDs to assign to the task.

notify_all.description: `True` to send notifications to all task watchers, including the creator.

start_date.description: Start date as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields to apply. See ClickUp API for structure.

due_date_time.description: `True` if `due_date` includes a specific time, `false` if it's an all-day task.

time_estimate.description: Estimated time to complete, in milliseconds.

custom_item_id.description: Custom task type ID. Omit or use `null` for standard tasks (recommended). Custom task types including Milestones (ID `1`) are subject to workspace plan quotas. Only specify a custom_item_id if you have confirmed the workspace has available quota for that task type. Use GET /team/{team_id}/custom_item to check available custom task types and their quotas.

custom_task_ids.description: Enables referencing tasks by custom task ID; requires `team_id` if `true`.

start_date_time.description: `True` if `start_date` includes a specific time, `false` if it's an all-day task.

check_required_custom_fields.description: `True` to enforce filling all required Custom Fields upon creation.

CLICKUP_GET_LIST.description: Retrieves detailed information for an existing List in ClickUp, identified by its unique `list_id`.

list_id.description: The unique identifier for the List to retrieve. This ID can be found by right-clicking a List in the ClickUp sidebar, selecting 'Copy link', and the ID is the last part of the URL after '/l/' or '/li/'.

CLICKUP_GET_FOLDERS.description: Retrieves Folders within a specified ClickUp Space, ensuring `space_id` is valid, with an option to filter by archived status.

archived.description: Filter Folders by archived status. `True` for archived, `False` for unarchived. Omit to return both.

space_id.description: The unique numeric identifier of the Space from which to retrieve Folders.

CLICKUP_GET_FOLDERLESS_LISTS.description: Retrieves all Lists within a specified Space that are not located in any Folder.
